Our team works daily with coatings, ink, adhesive, plastics and rubber producers, so we understand what your specification really needs.
Extensive export experience and a reliable logistics network, from documents and packing to delivery at your port.
Korean distribution partner of Cabot, Synthomer, Arkema and Syensqo, with an ISO 9001 certified quality system.
